name: gizza-ai/csv-filter
summary: Filter CSV rows by a column condition.

tool.description: Keep only the CSV rows where a column matches a condition. `condition` is '<column> <op> <value>' with op one of == != < <= > >= contains; the column is a header name (when header=true) or a 1-based index. Comparison is numeric when both the cell and value are numbers, otherwise string; contains is a case-insensitive substring. The header row is preserved.

condition.description: Row condition '<column> <op> <value>'. column is a header name (header=true) or 1-based index; op is one of == != < <= > >= contains. Numeric compare when both sides are numbers, else string; contains is a case-insensitive substring.

header.description: Treat the first row as a header (kept, and matchable by name). Default true.

delimiter.description: Field separator: a single char or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default ','.
